mapper.insert: insert into ai_ticket_flow_layout (flow_code, status_code, pos_x, pos_y, update_by, create_time) values (#{flowCode}, #{statusCode}, #{posX}, #{posY}, #{updateBy}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update pos_x = values(pos_x), pos_y = values(pos_y), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = values(create_time)
